citations.quote:
# 3 Decisions Drei Entscheidungen
We make every moment of our lives

situation.text: An image presents three decisions that individuals make every moment of their lives.

citations.quote: Tony event was my LV bag… No offense ladies…

observation.text: The author compares attending a Tony Robbins event to buying a luxury handbag.

citations.quote: Everything we do in life is an investment… time and money go in and out all the time!

observation.text: The text frames life choices as investments of time and money, contrasting standard material investments with personal development.

citations.quote: First big money I’ve made I invested in MBA - it’s 2016 University of Wollongong and 5 sessions a week with a personal trainer- no Joke did it in October 2016 both.

summary.text: The author reports investing their first substantial earnings in an MBA at the University of Wollongong and personal training sessions in October 2016, instead of luxury goods.

citations.quote: Instead of “Wanting to Have” - “ I wanted to Become!”

summary.text: The author values personal growth and becoming someone over owning material possessions.

citations.quote: And even if you do not spend any money on Developing your skills, or body… you pay for that - but more with the Opportunity Cost.

summary.text: Not investing in personal development can lead to paying with opportunity cost.
